definitions.historical_no_play_rows: excluded from recorded-event counts to align with supported SLC play event types
definitions.historical_terminal: last nonempty series_result for each drive; intermediate First down results are ignored
definitions.regular_season_filter: nfl_pbp season 2022-2025 and regular-season week 1-18; players league=nfl with GSIS id
definitions.score_only_overtime: included in terminal and scoring counts; excluded from modeled-drive event, yardage, and starting-position distributions when play_count is zero
definitions.variance: population variance over the observed team-game or modeled-drive reference distribution

historical.game_index_source: pinned regular-season PBP snapshot; unique game IDs, weeks 1-18 (nfl_pbp season 2022-2025 and regular-season week 1-18; players league=nfl with GSIS id)
historical.season_type: regular-season source snapshot; no game_type column
historical.source_filter: nfl_pbp season 2022-2025 and regular-season week 1-18; players league=nfl with GSIS id
